main_text.p: הַלְאָה הלא ultra, Ulterius: נְהַלְאָה f. Procul disita.

הָלַךְ Ambulavit, Ivit, Abivit, Adivit, Accesit. Niphal נֶהֱלַךְ Abire factus est. Pihel הֵלֵךְ Itavit, Ire fecit, Deduxit. Chal. Partic. מְהַלְּכִין Obambulans, plur. Hithpa-hel, הִתְהַלֵּךְ Itavit, Obambulavit.
הֲלִיכָה f. Ambulatio, Incessus: plur. הֲלִיכוֹת .
מַהֲלָךְ m. Iter, Profectio, Ambulacrum, Via: plur. מַהֲלָכִים .

הָלַל Insanire. Pihel הוֹלֵל Insanum, Stultum effecit: הֵילֵל Laudavit. Pyhal. הָלַל Laudatus fuit. Hiphil הְהַלִּיל Splenduit; Splendere fecit. Futurum, יְאַהֵל Splendebit, Job.25.5, cum epenthesi Aleph. Hithpahel הִתְהַלֵּל Laudavit, Jactavit se, Gloriatus fuit: הִתְהוֹלֵל Insanivit.
מְהֻלָּל הלול מְהֻלָּל m. תְּהִלָּה f. Laus, Laudatio: plur. תְּהִלּוֹת הַלּוּלִים .

page.notes: Hebrew and Greek text is partly blurred by water staining; several vowel points and the Hebrew forms in the entries are uncertain and may contain errors. Right-hand edge and lower corner show stains and a faint show-through, not transcribed.
